# Project Context: llm-judge-calibration

<!-- Auto-generated by /cortex-spec from spec artifacts. -->

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.12 — CLI scripts
- urllib — HTTP calls to Anthropic API (no pip dependency)
- Claude Haiku 4.5 — LLM judge model
- YAML frontmatter — rubric format (parsed with regex, no PyYAML dependency)

## Conventions

- Scripts in `scripts/cortex/` — Python CLI tools
- Rubrics in `docs/cortex/rubrics/{slug}/` — YAML frontmatter + markdown
- Calibration in `~/.cortex/calibration/` — global, JSONL, keyed by rubric hash
- JSON on stdout, warnings on stderr, exit 0 on non-fatal errors

## Architecture Rules

- Claude Haiku 4.5 only — no local models for judging
- Rubrics are separate files, not inline in contracts
- Calibration is global (cross-project), not per-project
- Judge runs independently from gate-check
- Confidence >= 0.7 auto-passes; < 0.7 flags for human review

## Write Boundaries

- `scripts/cortex/cortex-judge.py`
- `docs/cortex/rubrics/`
- `docs/cortex/evals/{slug}/judge-report.md`
- `~/.cortex/calibration/`
- `test/test_llm_judge.py`
